content_sections.heading: APWD Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 2-71/2025-PWD gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download APWD notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government/State Govt./UT Administration/PSUs/Semi Govt. Organization/Autonomous Organizations; (i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department; OR (ii) 5 years' regular service in Level-9 (53100-167800) or equivalent; OR (iii) 7 years' regular service in Level-7 (44900-142400) or equivalent; AND Degree in Civil Engineering from recognized University or having passed Part A & B Examination of Institution of Engineers (India) Experience: Five years professional experience in the field of Civil Engineering Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Applicant must be an officer under Central Government, State Government, UT Administration, PSU, Semi Govt. or Autonomous Organization Only officers who can be relieved immediately on selection should apply

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for APWD Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion Incomplete applications or applications without the complete set of essential documents shall be rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected officer may opt for pay fixed in the deputation post or pay of parent post plus deputation allowance, as per Ministry of Finance orders. Deputation (ISTC) initially for 2 years, which may be extended if required in accordance with the rules Period of deputation (ISTC) including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years Period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 04 years (terms and conditions, item 9) Selected officer will not be allowed to withdraw or refuse to join Sponsoring authority must release the selected officer within a month of the appointment letter/order

content_sections.heading: How Will APWD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Assessment of bio-data and supporting documents by the Selection Committee Information in the CV and supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate, signed and forwarded through proper channel Vigilance clearance certificate Integrity certificate Statement of penalty (Major/Minor) imposed, if any ACR dossier or ACRs for the last five years; photocopies attested on each page by an officer not below Under Secretary rank

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APWD Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, or download it from https://andamannicobar.gov.in/ or https://apwd.and.nic.in. Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) in duplicate, signed by the volunteering officer. Attach vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, statement of penalty if any, and ACR dossier or ACRs for the last five years. Have the application forwarded by the employer through proper channel. Application must reach the Deputy Secretary (PWD), A & N Administration Secretariat, Room No. 139, Sri Vijaya Puram-744101 within 60 days from publication of the circular. Make sure it reaches by 12 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature Applications not accompanied by supporting certificates for qualification and experience will not be processed Organisations not following Central pay scales should enclose the latest salary slip with pay break-up

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APWD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in APWD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Executive Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for APWD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the circular; Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram; https://andamannicobar.gov.in/ or https://apwd.and.nic.in) and send it to Office of the Deputy Secretary (PWD), A & N Administration Secretariat, Room No. 139, Sri Vijaya Puram- 744101, by forwarded by the employer through proper channel, to reach by 12 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-11 (Rs. 67700-208700) plus DA, Special Compensatory Allowance, Island Special Allowance and deputation allowance as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Civil Engineering from recognized University or passed Part A & B Examination of Institution of Engineers (India), with five years professional experience in Civil Engineering; plus analogous post on regular basis, or 5 years regular service in Level-9, or 7 years regular service in Level-7, or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be an officer under Central Government, State Government, UT Administration, PSU, Semi Govt. or Autonomous Organization. Only officers who can be relieved immediately on selection should apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion. Incomplete applications or applications without the complete set of essential documents shall be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of bio-data and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. Information in the CV and supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (ISTC) initially for 2 years, which may be extended if required in accordance with the rules. Period of deputation (ISTC) including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 04 years (terms and conditions, item 9).
